steps.en: Install the pack onto your coding agent
steps.zh: 把技能包装进你的 coding agent

steps.en: Skills become available and load when a relevant task is detected
steps.zh: 技能即刻可用，任务匹配时自动装载

steps.en: Ask for a review or an optimization in plain language
steps.zh: 用自然语言提出 review 或优化请求
steps.code: Review this React component for performance issues

steps.en: react-best-practices audits your code against Vercel Engineering's 40+ rules, prioritized by impact
steps.zh: 按 Vercel 工程 40+ 条规则审查代码并按影响排序

steps.en: On a deployed project, vercel-optimize pulls real Vercel metrics first, then audits only the routes they flag
steps.zh: 先拉真实 Vercel 指标，再只查被点名的路由

value.en: Vercel's own house rules for React performance, UI quality, and cost get applied by your agent without you authoring the rule sets
value.zh: Vercel 自家的 React 性能、UI 质量与成本规则由 agent 自动套用，不必你自己编写规则集

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09-27 (Installation): npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills
README.md (Usage): "Skills are automatically available once installed. The agent will use them when relevant tasks are detected."; example prompt "Review this React component for performance issues"
